Title: 3 Everyday Foods That Make Restless Legs Syndrome Worse

Description:
Legs feel a creeping, crawling itch the moment you lie down at night, making it hard to fall asleep? Restless legs syndrome is tied to dopamine signaling in the brain - and caffeine, alcohol, and salty snacks can all interfere with that signal.

Each one has a simple fix that doesn't mean giving it up for good - just a change in timing or amount.

Watch to find out why, and what to do instead.
